title: CopytradeEntryStatus
description: PLAN-2026-08-10-live-manual-bto: synchronous return value of the CopytradeSignalWorkflow.entryStatus Query. A Query emits NO Temporal commands, so this surface is replay-inert — it reports state the workflow already tracks. Added so an operator-initiated /live manual BTO can show WHY an entry did not happen: without it a gate rejection (EOD cutoff, notional cap, kill switch, missing live promotion) is indistinguishable from an accepted entry until someone reads audit_log. Also queryable on a CLOSED execution (the workflow completes ~90s after submit, on fill or entry-TTL expiry), which is what lets the dashboard keep polling past completion.

state.description: PENDING: the entry is still running the pre-order gates (transient). REJECTED: a gate refused it — no order was placed, no position exists; reason_code names the gate. SUBMITTED: the broker order is placed and the workflow is awaiting the fill. FILLED: the entry filled and a PositionWorkflow now owns the position. EXPIRED: the entry-TTL elapsed with no fill (EntryExpired). ABORTED: a kill-switch risk-breach cascade short-circuited the entry. FAILED: the workflow terminated on an unhandled failure (mirrors the EntryWorkflowFailed audit). Every state except PENDING is terminal for the ENTRY (FILLED hands off to the position's own lifecycle).

reason_code.description: Machine-readable refusal code when state=REJECTED — the same value the SignalRejected audit carries (e.g. NOTIONAL_CAP_EXCEEDED, MANUAL_QTY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS, STRATEGY_DISABLED, CAPITAL_UNAVAILABLE), or 'live_promotion_missing' for the LIVE promotion gate. Absent for every non-REJECTED state.

reason_detail.description: Human-readable detail for the refusal (e.g. 'manual_qty_exceeds_headroom requested=10 headroom=2'). Optional even when state=REJECTED — not every gate supplies one.

option_symbol.description: Resolved OCC option symbol. Absent when the entry was refused BEFORE contract resolution (the early gates: strategy-disabled, risk decision, capital-unavailable).

contracts.description: Contract count the entry was placed for, after sizing (or after the operator's qty_override). Absent until the order is submitted.

broker_order_id.description: Broker-assigned order id, present from SUBMITTED onward.

filled_qty.description: Cumulative filled quantity reported by the broker. Present when state=FILLED.

avg_fill_price.description: Average fill premium per contract, dollars. Present when state=FILLED.
